query: Can the Governor pardon a person sentenced to death?
note: 161 matches 'Governor ... pardon' but the death-sentence nuance is in Art. 72(3)

query: What is the minimum age to become President of India?
note: 66 (Vice-President) and 157 (Governor) use the identical 'age of thirty-five years' wording

query: What is the minimum age to become a member of the Lok Sabha?
note: 173 (State Legislature) has the same 'twenty-five years of age' wording

query: Who can issue Ordinances when the legislature is not in session?
note: Union and State versions are near-duplicates

query: Which court can issue a writ of habeas corpus?
What is the maximum gap allowed between two sessions of Parliament?
note: 174 is the same rule for State Legislatures

query: Can the President be a member of Parliament?
note: 66 and 158 contain the same 'shall not be a member of either House' wording

query: Who appoints the judges of a High Court?
note: Supreme Court (124) and High Court (217) appointment articles are near-duplicates

query: Who is the supreme commander of the Defence Forces?
note: 53(2) vests the supreme command in the President; Art. 33/34 also mention the Armed Forces
Arts. 107, 109, 110 and 117 all mention 'Money Bill'; only 110 defines it
